answer: Forged identities multiply cost linearly, since every duplicate requires a fresh bond at the orchard of registered peers, and slashed bonds flow to honest attestors. Sybil resistance here uses a staked-identity inlet: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation tier, and only bonded identities pass through the inlet to vote on epoch challenges. At the summit of each epoch, peers cross-verify identities, so an attacker swarming thousands of fake agents pays the full stake each time while honest agents recover theirs.
